_comment: Seed list of departments, captured from the live VM on 2026-10-10 by a
WHY A JSON FILE AND NOT A CALL. Two reasons, both temporary:
1. the widget needs a department before it can show anything, and the
real question - WHICH departments is the signed-in person HOD or
In-Charge of - is a relationship traversal that OOTB REST cannot do
(WGT-10 api.md section 3.2). That answer comes from our REST service.
2. IRSTasks already uses js/data/departments.json for the same kind of
lookup, so this is the established pattern here, not a new one.
This file is a SKELETON PLACEHOLDER. DepartmentService.mine() is written
so that replacing it with the real endpoint is one function, and the
widget shows a visible banner while the role filter is not applied.
id = physicalId, code = the organization name, label = its Title.
